g.text: Quantum computing is a type of computing that uses the principles of quantum mechanics to
perform operations on data. Unlike classical computers, which use bits (0s and 1s) as the
basic unit of information, quantum computers use quantum bits or qubits. These qubits can
Ahoy there! Quantum computing is like having a ship with multiple sails instead of just one.
In the olden days, we used to have one big sail that could only go forward or backward. But
now, we've got ships with three sails - two for going forward and one for turning around.
